claim: The original Unity 5.6.5p3 globalgamemanagers ClassID13 InputManager PathID2 carries a complete 31,408-byte original source record at 0x1228..0x8CD8 with SHA256 b83aa9d18a4a4b8c86cfe009555c077f122198ea4746f2f691bb69098020233d. Its original table has exactly 437 serialized input-axis rows. Every row's seven UTF8 string slots, three exact float32 bit-pattern words, four raw bytes and three signed int32 values are preserved in a compact lossless JSON witness, together covering all 31,404 bytes after the original four-byte count. Original names include Horizontal, Vertical, Submit (twice), Cancel, controller axis/button and mouse entries. Source input configuration only, not proof of retail player input dispatch or combat move bindings.
